text: Texas elected gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa, who supports a data center moratorium. The state accounts for approximately 27% of planned U.S. data center capacity. SpaceX fell 7%, CoreWeave 7%, Iren 6%, Nebius 3%, and Oracle 4.3%, while several major hyperscalers gained.

meta.note: The proposed moratorium is not enacted; reported capacity shares refer to planned projects.

text: McDonald's reported Q3 revenue of $7.16 billion (+1% YoY), adjusted EPS of $3.57, and net income of $2.49 billion. Global same-store sales rose 1.5%, while U.S. sales fell 0.2% amid lower traffic. International licensed markets grew 4.2%; operated markets rose 1.4%.

meta.note: U.S. traffic declined; the reported 0.2% decrease measures same-store sales rather than visit counts.
